加强医保监管体系建设等路径来完善我国医疗保障体系的建设
Exploration on the Development Paths of China's Medical Security System in the New Situation
WU Jin1 ，LIU Liang2 ，SHI Ping2 ，WANG Shuling2( 1． Zhejiang Pharmaceutical College，Ningbo，Zhejiang，China 315000; 2． Shenyang Pharmaceutical University，Shenyang，Liaoning，China 110016)Abstract: Objective To provide reference for optimizing the development paths of China's medical security system． Methods The relevant literature on the integration of commercial medical insurance and social medical insurance was consulted，the existing problems of China's medical security system was analyzed，and practical suggestions for the construction of China's medical security system in the new situation were put forward． Results and Conclusion There were some problems in China's medical security system in terms of medical insurance fund revenue and expenditure，the level of medical insurance reimbursement，and the supervision of medical insurance fund． It is suggested to improve the construction of China's medical security system by reforming medical insurance payment methods， promoting the development of commercial insurance，and strengthening the construction of the medical insurance supervision system．2017 年 10 月 18 日，习近平总书记在中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会上提出“完善统一的城乡居民基本医疗保险制度”的要求，为我国医疗保障体系的发展开拓了新的路径为人民提供完备的健康保障体系，既是各国政府的重要职责，也是维护社会稳定和有序健康发展的前提实现全民医保是我国医疗保障制度的终极目标。自 1998 年城镇职工基本医保制度建立以来，我国的医保改革已历经 20 余载，截至 2019 年末，我国基本医疗保险参保人数已有 135 436 万人，医保覆盖范围稳定在 95%以上，取得了举世瞩目的进展，然而也存在筹资渠道窄报销比例低医保基金套取现象等问题[ 1 ] 面对我国医保体系发展进展与阻力并存成绩与遗憾同在第一作者: 吴锦，女，硕士研究生，副教授，研究方向为社会保障政策、医药政策与药房管理，( 电子信箱) 84967586@ qq． com。
